cards.headline: The vocal is a real lockdown conversation
cards.snippet: In 2020, during lockdown, Fred again.. asked Marea Stamper, also known as The Blessed Madonna, how she was feeling one night, and she simply talked the way she normally would. The conversation was recorded, and Fred sampled it to build "Marea (We've Lost Dancing)." Stamper has said he turned her babble into something beautiful and personal. The track was the first time she lent her vocals to a song. The two had met in Palestine about five years earlier.
cards.context: Marea Stamper is The Blessed Madonna.

cards.headline: Released an hour after Boris's reopening news
cards.snippet: In 2021, Fred again.. released "Marea (We've Lost Dancing)," and he says the timing could not have been better. It came out literally an hour after Boris Johnson announced that the horizon of raves was in sight. Fred swears this was a pure coincidence, though it made him very happy. The song grew from a Zoom chat with Marea Stamper, The Blessed Madonna, about what had happened to their industry.
cards.context: The sample came from a Zoom chat with Marea about what had happened to their industry.

cards.headline: Neighbours with a very literal speaker upgrade
cards.snippet: My neighbours enjoyed this song so much that they picked a brick up and smashed it through my window to hear it better.
